text: Among the spectral radii tested in the NARMA-10 benchmark lab (0.5, 0.9, 0.99), which was observed to give the best performance for most reservoir sizes?
explanation: The lab reports ρ=0.9 outperforms both 0.5 (too little memory) and 0.99 (too close to instability) for most N. ρ=1.1 is not tested in this lab (a value above 1 risks losing the echo state property).
